questions.solution_text:
$f'(x)=\frac{4(3x^{2}-48x+144)}{5537}$
$3x^{2}-48x+144=0$
$x^{2}-16x+48=0$
$(x-4)(x-12)=0$
$x=4$ or $x=12$
$x=12$ is rejected because it lies outside $[0,7]$.
$f''(x)=\frac{4(6x-48)}{5537}$
$f''(4)=\frac{4(-24)}{5537}<0$, so $x=4$ is a maximum.
$f(0)=0$, $f(4)=\frac{1024}{5537}$ and $f(7)=\frac{700}{5537}$.
The mode is $4$.
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[every node/.style={font=\large}]
\begin{axis}[axis lines=middle, xlabel={$x$}, ylabel={$y$}, xmin=-0.9, xmax=8.4, ymin=-0.03, ymax=0.25, samples=100, clip=false, width=8cm, height=6cm, xtick={0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7}, ytick={0.05,0.1,0.15}]
\addplot[thick, domain=0:7] {4*(x*x*x-24*x*x+144*x)/5537};
\draw[dashed] (axis cs:4,0) -- (axis cs:4,0.1849);
\node[above] at (axis cs:4,0.2) {mode $=4$};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]

questions.solution_text:
$f'(x)=\frac{3(14-2x)}{464}$
$14-2x=0$
$x=7$
$x=7$ is rejected because it lies outside $[8,12]$.
With no stationary point in the support, $f'(x)=\frac{3(14-2x)}{464}<0$ for every $x$ in $[8,12]$.
The density is decreasing, so the maximum is at the left endpoint.
$f(8)=\frac{144}{464}$ and $f(12)=\frac{72}{464}$.
The mode is $8$.
